MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The thread checker was the one item I would choose: after several fastener purchases, identifying matching threads would help me sort hardware.",
    "It connected to a practical fastening task without assuming I already needed a particular size of nut or bolt."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Locking nuts do not meet the same need as framing nails, wood screws, and drywall anchors; I have no current bolt assembly that needs them.",
    "Wire gauges and milling cutters involve different work from my recent mounting and wood fastening tasks.",
    "Disposable medicine cups do not imply a need for glass beakers, and Panasonic vacuum bags do not establish that I can use Bissell cleaning formula.",
    "The thermometer, kerosene can, pressure gauge, and twelve wastebaskets lack a specific connection to anything I currently need to do."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My fastening purchases seemed to be treated as interest in almost any workshop tool or hardware supply.",
    "A shared measuring or cleaning purpose seemed to count too much when the actual use and equipment were different."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases center on fastening wood and mounting things, where fastener type, dimensions, and tool compatibility matter.",
    "A useful accessory needs to support a task I actually have; owning supplies does not mean I need equipment for unrelated work.",
    "My vacuum bag purchase points to a specific fit requirement, rather than a general need for cleaning products."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my practical hardware needs but stretched them into unrelated tasks, with only the thread checker offering a clear next use."
}
